name: Nelia
source:
The second princess of the Demon World. Her full name is Carnelian; however, since it's too lengthy, people around prefer to call her "Nelia." Since she was a child, she has been acquainted with Lithia.

While she is normally a perfectionist model student, she flips a switch and becomes a total seductress whenever Raito is around.

[spoiler]Her original plan was pure spite: she intended to steal the human the Divine Princess was obsessed with, seduce him, and then ruthlessly dump him. Instead, the plan backfired, and she fell for him the moment they met. Now she has to constantly fight her own feelings, telling herself, "I'm only here to make him fall for me so I can break his heart," just to stay the course.[/spoiler]

Likes: [spoiler]adoptive[/spoiler] grandmother, singing
Dislikes: mankind, the human world

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/character.html]official website[/url]]

Her name comes from Carnelian, a brownish-red gemstone.
